purpose: Acknowledge a result as fitting someone’s reputation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
さすが + expected evaluation; さすがに + reaction to a limit.
Just as you would expect from a teacher, your explanation is clear.
After walking for three hours, even I get tired.
formation: さすが + expected evaluation; さすがに + reaction to a limit.
restrictions: It often praises deserved ability, but the adverbial form has broader contextual uses.
mistake: It does not simply translate every occurrence of as expected.
